go broke: If you keep spending all your pocket money on online games, you will go broke before the end of the month.
如果你一直把零用錢都花在線上遊戲上，你會在月底前破產。
be flat broke: After paying for the concert tickets and the hotel, I was flat broke and had to borrow money for the bus.
付完演唱會門票和飯店錢後，我一毛不剩，只好借錢搭公車。
I'm broke: I can't go shopping with you this weekend because I'm broke until my parents give me money next week.
這週末我不能跟你去逛街，因為我沒錢了，要等下週爸媽給我錢。
a bronze medal: She finished third in the swimming race and proudly brought home a bronze medal for her country.
她在游泳比賽中得到第三名，驕傲地為國家帶回一面銅牌。
the Bronze Age: During the Bronze Age, people learned to mix copper and tin to make stronger tools and weapons.
在青銅器時代，人們學會將銅和錫混合，製作更堅固的工具和武器。
a bronze statue: In the middle of the park stands a bronze statue of the city's founder, made of shiny brown metal.
公園中央矗立著一座城市創建者的銅像，由閃亮的棕色金屬製成。
a brutal attack: The police are searching for the men who carried out a brutal attack on an old man late last night.
警方正在搜尋昨晚深夜對一位老人進行殘暴的攻擊的男子們。
the brutal truth: The doctor told him the brutal truth: unless he stopped smoking, his health would get much worse.
醫生告訴他殘酷的真相：除非他戒菸，否則他的健康會變得更糟。
brutal honesty: My coach is known for his brutal honesty; he tells us exactly what we did wrong, even if it hurts.
我的教練以毫不留情的坦率出名；即使會傷人，他也會直接告訴我們哪裡做錯了。
a brutal winter: The village suffered a brutal winter, with heavy snow and freezing temperatures that lasted for months.
那個村莊經歷了一個嚴酷的冬天，大雪和冰凍的氣溫持續了好幾個月。
be capable of doing: Amy is capable of doing the whole science project by herself, so the teacher let her work alone.
艾咪有能力自己完成整個科學專題，所以老師讓她獨自進行。
a highly capable manager: As a highly capable manager, Ms. Chen solved the shop's money problems and doubled its sales in one year.
身為一位非常能幹的經理，陳女士解決了店裡的財務問題，並在一年內使銷售額翻倍。
be capable of great cruelty: History shows that even ordinary people can be capable of great cruelty when war turns neighbors into enemies.
歷史顯示，當戰爭讓鄰居變成敵人時，即使是普通人也可能極端殘忍。
casual clothes: On Fridays, our school lets students wear casual clothes like T-shirts and jeans instead of uniforms.
每週五，我們學校讓學生穿T恤和牛仔褲等休閒服，而不必穿制服。
a casual remark: It was just a casual remark about her haircut, but she was upset and didn't talk to me all day.
那只是一句關於她髮型的隨口說的話，但她很不高興，一整天都不跟我說話。
casual workers: During the busy summer season, the hotel hires casual workers who work only a few weeks at a time.
在忙碌的夏季旺季，飯店會雇用一次只工作幾週的臨時工。
a casual glance: With just a casual glance at the menu, he ordered the first dish without really reading it.
他只是隨意一瞥菜單，沒有仔細看就點了第一道菜。
a casual attitude toward: Because of his casual attitude toward safety rules, he often rides his scooter without wearing a helmet.
由於他對安全規則漫不經心的態度，他常常騎機車不戴安全帽。
casual sex: In health class, the nurse explained that casual sex with people you barely know can bring serious health risks.
在健康課上，護理師說明與幾乎不認識的人發生隨意性行為可能帶來嚴重的健康風險。
be cautious about investing: After losing money in the stock market, my uncle has become cautious about investing in new companies.
在股市賠錢後，我叔叔對投資新公司開始持謹慎態度。
a cautious approach: The doctors took a cautious approach, slowly increasing the medicine a little each week to avoid side effects.
醫生們採取謹慎的做法，每週慢慢增加一點藥量，以避免副作用。
cautious optimism: With sales slowly rising again, the company's boss expressed cautious optimism about the coming year.
隨著銷售額慢慢回升，公司老闆對來年表達了審慎的樂觀。
be characteristic of the region: Heavy afternoon thunderstorms in summer are characteristic of the region, so locals always carry an umbrella.
夏季午後雷陣雨是該地區的典型特色，所以當地人總是隨身帶傘。
a characteristic feature: Red walls and curved roofs are a characteristic feature of traditional Chinese temples in Taiwan.
紅牆和彎曲的屋頂是台灣傳統中式寺廟的典型特徵。
with characteristic humor: When he dropped his cake on the floor, Grandpa laughed and, with characteristic humor, said the floor was hungry too.
爺爺把蛋糕掉到地上時笑了，以他一貫的幽默說地板也餓了。
a cheerful color: We painted the children's classroom a cheerful color, a bright yellow that makes everyone feel happy.
我們把孩子們的教室漆成明亮的色彩，一種讓大家都覺得開心的亮黃色。
a cheerful room: With sunlight, plants, and bright curtains, the library has become a cheerful room where students love to study.
有了陽光、植物和明亮的窗簾，圖書館變成了一個令人愉悅的房間，學生都喜歡在那裡讀書。
remain cheerful despite: My grandmother tries to remain cheerful despite her painful back, always smiling and telling us funny stories.
儘管背痛，我奶奶仍努力保持開朗，總是面帶微笑、跟我們說有趣的故事。
